<document id="card-metal">
TheˆPremiumˆmetalˆcardˆPremiumˆmembersˆgetˆaˆmetalˆdebitˆcard.ˆItˆworksˆexactlyˆlikeˆtheˆplasticˆcard,ˆwithˆtheˆsameˆnumber,ˆlimitsˆandˆcontrols.ˆ##ˆGettingˆyourˆmetalˆcardˆWhenˆyouˆupgradeˆtoˆPremium,ˆtheˆappˆasksˆwhetherˆyouˆwantˆaˆmetalˆcardˆnowˆorˆatˆyourˆnextˆrenewal.ˆIfˆyouˆorderˆitˆnow,ˆyourˆcurrentˆcardˆkeepsˆworkingˆuntilˆyouˆactivateˆtheˆmetalˆone.ˆ##ˆReplacingˆitˆReplacementsˆforˆaˆlost,ˆstolenˆorˆdamagedˆmetalˆcardˆareˆmetalˆandˆfreeˆonˆPremium.ˆExpeditedˆshippingˆisˆfreeˆonˆPremiumˆtoo,ˆandˆtakesˆ2ˆtoˆ3ˆbusinessˆdays.ˆ##ˆIfˆyouˆleaveˆPremiumˆYourˆmetalˆcardˆkeepsˆworkingˆuntilˆitˆexpires.ˆAfterˆthat,ˆorˆifˆyouˆneedˆaˆreplacement,ˆyou'llˆgetˆaˆplasticˆcard.ˆ##ˆDisposalˆMetalˆcardsˆcan'tˆbeˆcutˆwithˆscissors.ˆWhenˆyouˆreplaceˆone,ˆyouˆcanˆmailˆitˆbackˆtoˆusˆinˆtheˆprepaidˆenvelopeˆthatˆcomesˆwithˆtheˆnewˆcard,ˆandˆwe'llˆrecycleˆit.ˆContactlessˆworksˆonˆmetalˆcardsˆtheˆsameˆwayˆitˆdoesˆonˆplastic.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="plan-change">
ChangingˆyourˆplanˆYouˆcanˆmoveˆbetweenˆBasic,ˆPlusˆandˆPremiumˆinˆtheˆappˆunderˆProfile,ˆthenˆPlan.ˆYouˆdon'tˆneedˆtoˆcontactˆsupport,ˆthoughˆsupportˆcanˆmakeˆtheˆchangeˆforˆyouˆifˆyouˆask.ˆ##ˆUpgradingˆAnˆupgradeˆtakesˆeffectˆimmediately.ˆWeˆchargeˆtheˆnewˆplan'sˆfullˆmonthlyˆfeeˆthatˆday,ˆandˆthatˆdayˆbecomesˆyourˆnewˆbillingˆdate.ˆYourˆnewˆlimits,ˆfeesˆandˆsavingsˆrateˆapplyˆfromˆthatˆmoment.ˆ##ˆDowngradingˆAˆdowngradeˆtakesˆeffectˆonˆyourˆnextˆbillingˆdate.ˆYouˆkeepˆyourˆcurrentˆplan'sˆfeaturesˆuntilˆthen.ˆWeˆdon'tˆrefundˆpartˆofˆaˆmonth.ˆ##ˆThingsˆtoˆcheckˆbeforeˆyouˆdowngradeˆ-ˆIfˆyouˆuseˆCushionˆandˆmoveˆtoˆBasic,ˆCushionˆswitchesˆoff.ˆAnyˆnegativeˆbalanceˆstillˆhasˆtoˆbeˆrepaid.ˆ-ˆYourˆSavingsˆPocketsˆstartˆearningˆtheˆnewˆplan'sˆrateˆonˆtheˆdayˆtheˆdowngradeˆtakesˆeffect.ˆ-ˆAˆPremiumˆmetalˆcardˆkeepsˆworkingˆuntilˆitˆexpires.ˆReplacementsˆafterˆthatˆareˆplastic.ˆ-ˆIfˆthisˆisˆyourˆfirstˆpaidˆplanˆandˆyouˆwereˆchargedˆlessˆthanˆ14ˆdaysˆago,ˆleavingˆtheˆpaidˆplanˆgetsˆyouˆaˆfullˆrefundˆofˆthatˆcharge.ˆSeeˆ"Refundsˆofˆplanˆfees".ˆThere'sˆnoˆlimitˆonˆhowˆoftenˆyouˆcanˆchangeˆplans.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
<document id="plan-premium">
TheˆPremiumˆplanˆPremiumˆcostsˆ$15.00ˆaˆmonth.ˆItˆremovesˆnearlyˆeveryˆfeeˆweˆcharge,ˆcomesˆwithˆaˆmetalˆcard,ˆandˆhasˆtheˆhighestˆlimitsˆandˆsavingsˆrateˆweˆoffer.ˆ##ˆWhat'sˆincludedˆ-ˆ**Monthlyˆfee:**ˆ$15.00ˆ-ˆ**ATMs:**ˆnoˆTallowbrookˆfeeˆatˆanyˆATMˆinˆtheˆUS,ˆandˆweˆreimburseˆATMˆownerˆsurchargesˆupˆtoˆ$10.00ˆaˆmonth.ˆ-ˆ**Foreignˆtransactionˆfee:**ˆ0%ˆofˆtheˆpurchaseˆamountˆ-ˆ**Cardˆreplacement:**ˆfreeˆ-ˆ**Expeditedˆcardˆshipping:**ˆfreeˆ-ˆ**SavingsˆPockets:**ˆ3.75%ˆAPYˆ-ˆ**Cushion:**ˆfee-freeˆcoverageˆupˆtoˆ$200ˆonˆdebitˆcardˆpurchasesˆ-ˆ**Dailyˆcardˆspendingˆlimit:**ˆ$10,000ˆ-ˆ**DailyˆATMˆlimit:**ˆ$1,500ˆ##ˆGoodˆtoˆknowˆPremiumˆmembersˆcanˆgetˆanˆemergencyˆreplacementˆcardˆdeliveredˆabroadˆwithinˆ3ˆbusinessˆdaysˆatˆnoˆcost.ˆYourˆcardˆisˆmetal,ˆandˆreplacementsˆareˆmetalˆtoo.ˆYouˆcanˆchangeˆplansˆanyˆtimeˆinˆtheˆappˆunderˆProfile,ˆthenˆPlan.ˆUpgradesˆstartˆrightˆaway.ˆDowngradesˆstartˆonˆyourˆnextˆbillingˆdate.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
</documents>
